assessments.reasoning: The main and library productions distinguish the presence of a query body. The optional Module Feature clause requires the named static error upon either a module declaration or a module import when the feature is absent.

challenge.method: Try assigning both a declaration and query body to the same module. Compare a main module without an import with a library module and a main module whose prolog contains an import in a processor lacking the feature.
challenge.results: A declaration and a query body are incompatible in one module. With the feature absent, an ordinary main module remains available and either declaration or import triggers XQST0016.

limitations: The source is the exact acquired W3C edition identified by the evidence record. The observed 2021 metadata notice and independently inspected linked context do not supply a different normative edition.
The rule applies to the XQuery 3.1 Module Feature and leaves namespace resolution, location hints and handling under the provided feature separate.
